about: The recall measure of the Aqua plan's S8: twenty hints a person might give, each reworded from the post it should find, against one seeded athanor. Written before thread.search was built and kept unchanged after. A hint's queries are its own words that are not in `stopwords` and have three letters or more, each searched alone, as a model trying the words of the hint would; a hint is found when any of its queries answers the post it names among the twenty results, and its thread is found when any answers a post of that thread. The share is reported, not gated (Aqua.RecallMeasureTest).

posts.content: Can you go through the sleep tracker data from my watch and tell me if anything stands out?
Your deep sleep averaged 58 minutes a night, lowest on nights after a late coffee.
The internet provider's technical support called about replacing the router.
Noted: a new router is booked for Friday morning, between 8 and 12.
Can you look at how Nvidia's chart has been moving and whether the 50-day average still holds?
Opened a workspace thread: NVDA technical analysis
Look at how Nvidia's chart has been moving and whether the 50-day average still holds.
RSI is at 71, so it reads overbought; the stock is above its 50-day moving average, with support near 118.
Technical analysis of NVDA done: momentum strong, support at 118, resistance at 135.
Remind me to call the plumber about the leaking sink on Thursday.
Noted: Thursday, the plumber, the leaking sink under the bathroom basin.
What was the name of the ramen bar Jonas recommended?
Jonas recommended Menya Kouji on Rua das Flores; it opens at noon.
Put together a budget for redoing the kitchen: cabinets, countertops and an induction hob.
Quotes so far: cabinets €6,400, quartz countertops €2,150, induction hob €890. Total €9,440.
Plan the upgrade of the homelab Kubernetes cluster from 1.30 to 1.32.
Drained node pi-3 and upgraded kubeadm; an etcd snapshot was saved before the control plane upgrade.
Plan three days in Lisbon for October, mostly walking and food.
Day 1: an Alfama walk and the Castelo de SÃO JORGE. Day 2: Belém, with pastéis at the old bakery. Day 3: Sintra by train from Rossio.
Gather what I need for this year's tax return.
Collected the 1099-B from the brokerage, the mortgage interest statement and the receipts for the home office.
Help me find a birthday gift for Mia; she is into photography and crafts.
Shortlist: a film camera (an Olympus mju II), a pottery class voucher, or the Ghibli art book.
The cluster in the closet needs its yearly upgrade, can you plan it?
My password manager keeps logging me out on the phone.
That is usually the auto-lock timer: set it to 15 minutes under Settings, then Security.
Draft a polite email declining the conference invitation.
Here is a draft: Thank you for inviting me to speak in Helsinki; I am grateful, but I cannot attend this year.
How far did I walk on Sunday?
Your watch logged 12,480 steps on Sunday, about nine kilometres.
Morning! Anything on the calendar today?
Good morning. Two meetings: the dentist at 10 and a call with Priya at 16.
